question: What purification step follows contemplation of the divine abode in ritual?
premises: The divine abode is contemplated first.
Substance-purification is the next required action.
The practitioner is instructed to arrange this purification.
inference: After contemplating the divine abode, one should arrange the purification of substances.
plain_english: Then, having contemplated the divine abode, one should arrange the purification of the substances.
